trigger.plain: Buy stop one tick over yesterday's high, trailed daily until it fills.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line.
decisions.reason: Position system, fresh break: W swing_class HH/HL, H1 swing_class HH/HL at the 20-hr high, D 3.1% under the 20-day high. D swing_class HH but LL and thin volume are cautions, not rejects.

trigger.plain: Hold; add on the next signal via buy stop over yesterday's high (30% then 20%).

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line. Or a red bar then a sell below its low.
decisions.reason: Held, position system: W, D, H1 swing_class HH/HL, D 0.3% above the last swing high, D last_bar green so no exit flip. Add only on a later signal (C30).

trigger.plain: Wait for a daily close above the last pivot high before any add.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line. Or a red bar then a sell below its low.
decisions.reason: Held, no break yet: D 3.3% under the last swing high, W 0.9% under, all HH/HL, D last_bar green so no exit. Position system needs the break first (C26); add only then.

declarations: System picked from each name's own picture: position system (C26-C30, R13-R15); lane not used.
Declared proxies: swing highs and EMA grid stand in for the resistance line; red D bar = trend-colour flip (R15). cmf and bar_high levels read by field only.
C21 is a house rule, not Seow's.
